hyvorTalk.upgradeText: This integration allows you to use <link>Hyvor Talk</link> on your blog for FREE. Upgrade to any plan to use this integration. This integration is not available in the trial period.
hyvorTalk.introText: <link>Hyvor Talk</link> is a privacy-first commenting, newsletter, and memberships platform. You can use it for free on your blog.
hyvorTalk.introNote: When you connect Hyvor Talk to your blog, we will automatically create a new website ID in Hyvor Talk for this blog under your account.
hyvorTalk.connectedTo: This blog is connected to website ID {websiteId} in Hyvor Talk. Visit the Hyvor Talk Console to manage comments and memberships.

hyvorTalk.themeFilesNote: You can also add it directly into your theme files. Feel free to customize the code (see <link>Hyvor Talk docs</link>).

connectModal.intro: Please confirm that you want to create a website ID in Hyvor Talk for this blog.

connectModal.point4: If you have any other websites on Hyvor Talk, you will need a separate subscription.

urlChange.title: URL Change
urlChange.intro: You are about to change the URL of your blog!
urlChange.point1: Previously shared links may break. However, when changing from hyvorblogs.io subdomain to a custom domain or self-hosting, we'll redirect users to the new URL.
urlChange.point2: This may impact the SEO of your blog.
urlChange.point3: We'll update the media links in your post content and blog settings. This may take some time.
